title: 止界往事（完） 欢迎回来
slug: 这个文字冒险游戏绝对有毒
content_zh:
延绵千里的森林之前，一行人从远方的平原上极速飞来，在为首一名金发男子的带领下，鱼贯而入，消失在森林与平原的交界。
“B区域探测完毕，安全！”
“E区也没问题……”
半小时后，听着通讯器中依次响起的声音，金发男子在面前虚空一点。
一具漂浮在半空的机械头盔破隐显现，其中传出熟悉的机械音：“不会错，根据空间检测仪的探定，最后的时空波长正是在这附近消失的。”
“也就是说，那两个人此刻就在这片森林里？”天子皱眉问。
“是的，按照波长消失的时间推算，两人应该还没有时间逃离森林。”
“很好，所有人，按原计划行动。”天子在通讯器中下令。
“都抓紧干活……妈的追了半年了，这次一定要逮住这两货！”
恶魔和微笑的声音依次从通讯器中响起。
“大家注意都低调些，这里是精灵的地盘，布置陷阱的时候，不要随便破坏树木，会招惹到精灵的仇恨。”
“四人一组，不要分开，有神皮的都开着，没有的也务必保证手边有风系魔法随时准备着，一旦接到艾娃警报，立即开启风墙！”
“明白！”
数百人的玩家队伍纷纷回应，在森林各处忙活了起来。
“话说，这两个人怎么突然跑到了精灵的地盘？”
“谁知道……”
两人分配好任务，正闲聊着，通讯器中忽然响起一声惨叫。
“啊……”
不等这声大叫落下，又是连续三道声音此起彼伏的响起。
“怎么回事？”恶魔忙问。

“坐标R区145，265，四名成员遭遇敌人袭击，当场死亡！”艾娃汇报。
“怎么可能？不是让你随时警报么？”
“战斗区域并未出现时空波长反应……敌人是用其他手段靠近了我们的成员。”艾娃说。
“其他手段？”众人都是一惊，他们这批人可都是全副武装的精英，而且能力高度互补，一般的手段都是不会奏效，能达到眼下这种神不知鬼不觉的效果，唯有神权。
也就是说，对方两人在这段时间又掌握了新的神权？
在场都是精英，立即意识到，这次敌人忽然跑来精灵之森，莫非是针对他们的一次‘陷阱’，想勾引他们进来，然后利用信息差反杀他们一波报仇？
“时空反应又出现了……位于无人区域……对方在转移位置……”艾娃的汇报再次响起。
“所有成员，立即进入防御模式，阵线向内收缩。”天子朝通讯器中下令，同时开启神皮，全速朝事发位置冲去。
天子沉稳的声音让众人紧张的心情暂时安定了一些。
然而下一秒，又是接连几道惨叫响起，夹杂其中的还有一道男子的冷笑声。
“呵呵，晚了！”
森林边缘某处，Z界行者看着面前惨死的四具玩家尸首，朝远处的红袖打了个手势，正准备继续前往下一处地点。
侧方一道破空声骤然袭来。
Z界行者皱了下眉，并未太在意，下意识的按下手指，周围时间自然的静止下来。
止界开启，Z界行者胜券在握的转头，想要先看看胆敢主动过来偷袭自己的鼠辈是谁。
然而转过头，迎接他的却是一柄并未并时间凝滞的镰刀刀锋。
“噗！”
刀光闪过，在Z界行者颈前留下一道血线，随鲜血一同迸溅而出的，还有Z界行者的灵魂。
对面，林雪的体表，死神的虚影已经第一时间浮现，伸手掠过空中的那团灵魂，一口吞下。
止界自然解除。

“不！”
女子的悲呼声响起，不远处察觉到不对的红袖狂奔而来，却还是晚了一步，只能眼睁睁看着丈夫的身体失去生机，直挺挺倒地。
红袖呆滞原地，半响都没能回过神来。
十数秒后，她才再次抬头，死死盯着林雪，双目通红，面容变得扭曲：“我要你死！”
红袖手持死神锁链朝林雪冲来。
林雪则只是静静的看着她，同样双手握住了镰刀。
止界却在此时突然开启。
红袖被凝滞在原地，陷入时间静止，而她隆起的腹中一阵蠕动，肚皮上露出一张娃娃的人脸，正是寄宿于红袖孩子转生的左丘。
这张人脸此刻看着对面的林雪，却露出极其惊骇的神色，刚才Z界行者的死已经让他明白了什么，哪里还敢上前战斗，急忙操控着被愤怒支配的红袖，转身朝远处奔逃而去。
红袖刚刚动身，前方不远处已经出现了一道椭圆形传送口。
但就在红袖即将踏入传送阵之时，一柄刀锋从红袖身后刺入，贯穿了她的腹部，将其中尚未成型的婴儿带了出来。
左丘浑身是血的被穿刺在镰刀尖端，面容因痛苦而扭曲，浑身生机很快消散。
临死之前，看着下方面无表情的女人，他心中还保持着最后的疑问：为什么，这个地方会出现时间观测者……
“什么？你说战斗已经结束？”
“是的，现场出现了另一批玩家，对方应该是提早埋伏再次，刚才在很短时间内秒杀了两名……不，是三名敌人。”
“……”
听着通讯器中艾娃的汇报，天子和君权神授的一群人，很快从四面八法赶来，将案发现场围聚了起来。
而刚一到场，众人就看到地上的三具尸体，一男一女一婴儿，其中的女人腹部洞开，腹中胎儿不翼而飞，而女人浑身则像是快速老去一般，变成了满头白发浑身枯槁的老人，带着极度的不甘和惊恐死去。
此刻众人却没空理会这三具尸体，而是都如临大敌的紧盯着场中唯一一个还站着的人影。
那是一个身披红袍，手持镰刀的女人，面色苍白，看起来有些病弱，双眼布满血丝，黑眼圈极其浓重，似乎已经很久没有入睡。

虽然这女人看起来像是受了重伤的样子，此刻却没人敢随意接近她，毕竟人家身上漂浮的死神神皮可不是摆设。
众人面面相觑，都有些震惊。
从现场情况看，这三人明显都是死在这女人手中，要知道这对夫妻可是他们追杀了大半年，都没能得手的敌人……众人都很好奇，这个女人的实力究竟有多强？
“小雪！”
“雪姐！”
陆瑶和小雅这时从旁边的丛林中走出，快步跑到了林雪身边，却也都是有些惊骇的看向林雪。
如今已经是她们到达精灵森林的第四天，四天前，当陆瑶听林雪说，接下来要在这里伏击‘Z界行者’时，她已经做好了恶战一场的准备，毕竟这个Z界行者可是现在世界头号通缉犯，整日神出鬼没，已经有大量玩家丧生在对方手中。
结果，真正动手时，林雪却只是让她用遗物帮忙隐匿了一下身形，便独自靠近了敌人，随后在所有人都不知道发生了什么的时候，就已经完成了秒杀。
“咳……几位美女，你们也和这两人有仇啊？”
对面，君权神授一行人沉默过后，由最擅长交际的‘微笑’代表众人开口。
对面这三位解决了Z界行者，照理说应该不是敌人，可偏偏这个女子身上又保持着死神的神皮……
要知道死神可一直是Z界行者身边那个同伙的标志，这半年来他们对死神也专门进行过不少研究，却没想到现在又冒出一个新的死神代理人，这让众人一时都有些分不清敌我。
再结合这女子现身的位置和时间，众人已经猜到，之前Z界行者两人忽然改变方向来精灵之森，目的多半就是来找这个女人。
“算是仇人……但这次，我真正要找到的人是你。”林雪忽然看向天子。
众人都是一愣，齐齐朝天子看去。
“不知阁下找我有什么事？”天子面色平静，一边回应林雪，一边快速在脑中与艾娃交流，让艾娃查探林雪的身份。
眨眼间，林雪在地球上的众多资料便已经呈现在天子眼前。
天子看着这些资料却既惊讶又茫然，惊讶的是林雪的身份很普通，行事极为低调，万万没想到天朝民间还隐藏有这种高手。
茫然的则是，他实在看不出林雪的身份背景和他有什么交集。
“梦境世界的入口是你封闭的吧？”林雪问。

“是我没错。”天子点头。
“很好，我需要你帮我一旁的小雅眼疾手快的扶住。
“……就当做是，我帮你击杀这三个通缉人员的报酬。”林雪补充道。
天子闻言皱眉，看了眼地上的三人，再看看林雪：“我能问问为什么吗？”
他问的是对方为什么要进梦界，据他所知那里面现在已经是梦魇兽的天下，没有什么探索的价值。
“为了去救一个人。”
“救谁？”
“我的爱人，也是这个世界的救世主。”
这话一出，却让对面一群人听得直皱眉头。
救世主？
“美女可否说的明白些？救世主什么意思？没有他这个世界就会毁灭？”恶魔皱眉问了出来。
“是的，这是一个没有希望的世界，因为救世主没能诞生，导致这条世界线的历史已经偏离了轨道，人类最终将在多年后败给噬神兽，并在百年后的大灾纪中灭绝。”林雪尽量加快语速，但快而不乱，她知道不说清楚一些东西，很难让对方相信她。
众人闻言面面相觑，脸色更加古怪。
“这种事情，你怎么会知道？”有人质疑。
“因为，我不是这个时空的人，而是来自另一个世界线——那条正确的世界线。”林雪说。
“啊？”
先发出质疑的却不是君权神授的众人，而是陆瑶和小雅，两人都是震惊又茫然的看着林雪。
而君权神授众人看到对方三人的表现，都觉得更不可理喻，感情连你自己的同伴都不知情？要让他们如何相信？
接下来众人又连接询问了林雪一些所谓的‘另一个世界’的诸多细节，林雪一一作答。
但在听她说到上一个世界，天子和君权神授败给了别人，秩序之城城主也换成了别人时，恶魔已经第一个冷笑出声：“胡扯，你说天子输给别人？怎么可能？我不相信这世上有人会比天子更优秀！”

林雪没有回答恶魔，而是看向天子，认真道：“你是很优秀，但很遗憾，你并不是‘正确’的人，你修炼的再强大，再有领导能力，统合了全世界人类，你也拯救不了世界。”
“那你说到底什么样的人能拯救世界？”有人问。听林雪连续贬低首领，众人心头都有了火气。
“时间之子。”
林雪却说出了一个似是而非的答案。
“时间之子？”
“什么鬼……”
对面众人彻底嚷嚷起来，都觉得这女人是在胡言乱语，没有一个人信她的话。
倒是天子，一直在平静的沉思，直到刚刚林雪说出‘时间之子’时，他神色忽的一变，有些意外的看向林雪。
“没有时间了，必须立即开启梦界，否则，我不知道他还能撑多久！”林雪忽然有些着急的催促。
“天子，你不会真信了她的话吧？这女人明显是个疯子，在胡言乱语罢了！梦境世界我们当初可花了极大的代价才封锁住，怎么可以随便解封？”恶魔看向天子劝说。
“一个疯子，能帮忙我们解决我们追杀了半年都抓不住的敌人？”天子反问。
恶魔被噎的说不出话。
其他人也都有些脸红。
没办法，人家实打实的战绩就摆在眼前，众人无话可说。
天子看向林雪：“既然很赶时间，就跟我来吧。”
说完便当先朝森林深处飞去。
林雪看天子被说动，总算松了口气，让小雅和陆瑶带着，跟上了对方。
其他君权神授的人对视了一眼，也急忙快步跟了上去。
一行人穿过传送阵，很快再次来到了翡翠城，世界之树下方。
这次莱莉没有阻拦，直接让树人放行，但只有天子、林雪、小雅和陆瑶被允许登陆世界树。

“我相信你，不是因为你帮忙击杀了那两人……”
木制‘电梯’行进的过程中，天子忽然开口解释。
“而是因为我过去也曾产生过一些错乱感，尤其是在我继承秩序城主之后，总会时常觉得，现在这个身份很不真实，好像原本不该属于我，而是另一个人……”
“我能够预感到，继续这样走下去，世界终究会走向一个我无法处理的结局……”
天子好似自言自语的说着，后方三个女人也都一言不发的听着。
“总之，我不能让这个世界的前程毁灭在我的手中……为此，我愿意赌一把……”
天子这才回头，直视向林雪：“所以，如果真有你说的那个人……把他带回来，将这个世界还原为它原本应该的样子……”
“多谢，我会的。”林雪认真的点头。
她现在很庆幸这个世界的秩序城主是天子，否则，换了其他人，就算相信了她的话，能否甘愿让出这个‘第一人’位置，去充当他人的绿叶，要打个大大的问号。
片刻后，四人到达了树冠，在莱莉的带领下来到了世界树的核心之地，沉梦之间。
此刻的沉梦之间，四周墙壁已经被密密麻麻的秩序符文覆盖，这些都是隔绝两界的封印。
天子取出秩序之笔，动手之前，又看向林雪：“先说好，我虽然相信你，但也不会置这个世界于不顾。”
“为了避免真实世界被梦魇兽入侵，在
“也就是说，如果你死在梦境世界，就会真的死去，没有回来的机会。”天子看着林雪，面色严肃的重申了这趟行动的风险。
“我明白，开始吧。”
林雪点了点头。她从进入这里开始，也就没有打算再回来。
“雪姐……”
这时身后的小雅和陆瑶都是担忧的看向林雪。
林雪也有些歉意的看向两人：“抱歉，真的没时间解释了，我必须立即出发……对不起……”
这个世界她觉得最愧疚的就是陆瑶和小雅，两人这几天帮了她许多，可她甚至连情况都来不及说明清楚……虽然说明了她们也会很快在修正之力下遗忘。

转眼间，天子那边已经挥动毛笔，随着墙面上的秩序符文流动，一个椭圆形的口子渐渐在密集的符文中间成型。
天子对林雪点了点头。
林雪快步跑到一张木床前，躺了下去，闭上了眼睛。
一只梦蝶自然的悬停在她额头……
林雪再次睁眼时，已经出现在梦境世界中。
但眼前的梦境世界却和印象中大不相同，原本童话画风的世界，此刻却遍布着密密麻麻的黑影。
这种外形如同影鬼一般的东西，就是所谓的梦魇兽。
它们在这个无人管束的世界，已经繁衍了不知多少代，此刻放眼望去，周围黑压压一片，全是这种东西。
最近的一只梦魇兽很快发现了林雪，咆哮着朝她扑来。
林雪急忙具现出了死神镰刀，一道劈出，梦魇兽被拦腰斩断，化为黑气消散。
这东西似乎比想象中脆弱，但架不住数量实在太多，而且就算击杀了，黑气也会很快在附近的位置再次凝聚成型。
周围的梦魇兽被这里的动静惊醒，更多的黑影扑来，林雪赶忙继续挥刀，不断击杀一只又一只的梦魇兽。
然而看着眼前黑压压看不到头的景象，林雪心中也不由升起了一股绝望。
在梦境世界里去时间之心，必须先在心里想着这个地方，然后坚持行走一天一夜，时间之心才会出现。
也就是说，接下来她必须在这里一刻不间断的战斗整整24个小时……
林雪努力拖着疲惫的身躯挥刀，驱散周围的几只黑影，却觉得眼皮沉重的要命。
如果是平时也就算了，可她之前已经连续熬了四五个夜晚，身体早已困乏到了极点，接下来要继续高强度的战斗一天一夜，她真能做得到么？她当然那有足够的动力和恒心，但有些事情，不是空有意志力就行的……
就在林雪感觉有些绝望之时，一道翠绿的光辉降落在她身上，治愈了她伤口的同时，还令她精神和体力同时一振。
林雪诧异的回头，就见身后，小雅不知何时也出现在了梦境世界。
她身上只穿着单薄的衣物，手中勉强具现出了一柄魔杖，正在费力的维持着魔法。

“小雅，你……”
林雪吃惊，实在没想到小雅竟会跟着她进来。
她进这里是一门心思要去时间之心寻回挚爱，进来就没想过出去，而小雅呢？
不管她是因为什么，只要进了这里，便没有了退路。也就是说，在入睡的那一刻，她已经做好了牺牲在这里的准备……
想通这些，林雪既感动又难过的看着小雅，一时不知该说什么好。
小雅此时终于渐渐适应了具现的规则，在身上凝聚了更多的衣物，看向林雪笑道：“雪姐你不用自责，这是我自己的决定，与你无关。”
“刚才天子开启梦境入口的一刻，我忽然感觉非常熟悉，直到此时真的进来，我越发确定，我曾经一定来过这里……”
小雅眼角含泪看向林雪，微笑道：“雪姐，那个对你我都很重要的人，你一定要将他带回来，这也是我的愿望！”
她刚刚说完，林雪忽然暴起，将她扑到了一旁，险险躲开后方袭来的一只梦魇兽。
但两人这一倒地，却给了更多梦魇兽机会。
周围数只最近的黑影见到如此良机，都是疯了一般的朝两人扑来。
但就在两人即将丧命之时，后方数枚火球砸出，准确命中了几只阴影。
“陆瑶？”
林雪看着后方刚刚现身的熟人，又一次惊讶。
“日，这地方规则怎么这么麻烦？快教教我怎么具现遗物！”
后方陆瑶骂骂咧咧走来。
靠近之后，对上两人询问的目光，陆瑶挠了挠头，尴尬道：“哎呀，别这么看我行不行？我也就是不忍心看着你们两个一个个送死，一时上头就跟着进来了，其实我他娘现在后悔的要死！怎么就跟你们一起进来发疯了……”
陆瑶解释着，周边更多的阴影已经扑来。
三人只能暂停了交流，赶忙背靠背释放魔法，将附近的黑影挨个驱散。
“喂，小雪，照你的说法，只要将你说的‘那个人’救回来，世界就会被修正回正轨，到时候我们也会重新活过来，对吧？”

趁着战斗的间隙，陆瑶询问。
“嗯，当然！”林雪连忙点头。
“那就好……”
陆瑶松了口气，释然笑道：“否则，我们三个一起死在这里，今后连个互相烧纸的人都没有，哈哈哈……”
“……”
林雪心中感动，说不出更多感激的话，只知道这一趟行动绝不能失败的理由，又多了两个。
有了两人的加入，原本艰难的路程一下轻松了很多。
陆瑶很快学会了具现遗物，在她遗物的隐匿作用下，三人的战斗频率被大幅减少。
如此，终于是成功在数不清的梦魇兽群中，坚持过了整整一天一夜。
第二天，也就是林雪来到这个世界的第三十五天，那座令她朝思暮想的时间之城，再次出现在她眼前。
城市门前的梦境森林，似乎已经被梦魇兽门啃食殆尽，时间之心的大门，就这么直接的敞开在前方的迷雾中。
林雪此时身体的疲惫已经到达了极点，但还是强撑着精神，跌跌撞撞跑向了那座城门。
但直到接近城门，她才意识到身后两人并没有跟来，回头一看，发现小雅和陆瑶都已经被梦魇兽阻隔在了后方，几乎被黑影的浪潮淹没。
林雪下意识的想去救援，远处两人却都是拼命挥手，示意她别过来，赶紧去完成该做的事。
林雪咬了咬嘴唇，狠心回头，更加快速的跑向了城门，奔向那个心碎和缘起之地……
房间中，沐游缓缓睁开了眼，眼中闪过浓重的叹息和沧桑之色。
一幕幕的回忆画面涌上心头，他终于彻底想起了他和林雪在那两千年间的经历。
面前，女儿还在摸索着他的胡须，嘴里咿咿呀呀叫着：“妈妈不哭，妈妈不哭……”
“放心吧，保证不会再让你妈妈哭了……”
沐游欣慰的看着女儿，抱起她，迫不及待的冲出了门。

二楼的书房中。
林雪坐在窗台的阳光下，手中照着教程打着一团毛线。
脚步声响起，沐游抱着女儿，忽然推门而入。
林雪一愣，看着他神色匆忙的样子，不由好笑道：“什么事这么着急？你现在可是当爹的人了，要更稳重些啊……”
“小雪，我回来了！”沐游忽然出声，打断了她。
林雪一怔，抬头诧异的看向沐游。
看着他深情的目光，曾经那无比熟悉的感觉再一次回归身体，林雪很快意识到了什么，眼睛瞬间湿润了下去，只感觉心中一下有千般的委屈想要对他诉说。
委屈之中却又夹杂着许多欣慰和惊喜，最后统统化为一个带泪的微笑。
“嗯，欢迎回来。”
（番外完）
content_en:
In front of the forest that stretches for thousands of miles, a group of people flew in from the distant plain at high speed. Led by a blond man at the head, they filed in and disappeared at the junction of the forest and the plain.
"Detection of area B completed, safe!"
"There's no problem in Area E..."
Half an hour later, listening to the voices that sounded in the communicator one after another, the blond man felt a little empty in front of him.
A mechanical helmet floating in mid-air appeared, and a familiar mechanical voice came from it: "It's correct. According to the detection of the space detector, the last wavelength of space and time disappeared near here."
"In other words, those two people are in this forest right now?" The emperor asked with a frown.
"Yes, judging from the time it took for the wavelength to disappear, the two of them should not have time to escape the forest."
"Very good, everyone, proceed as planned." The emperor ordered through the communicator.
"Hurry up and work... Damn, I've been chasing them for half a year. I must catch these two guys this time!"
The voices of the devil and the smile sounded from the communicator one after another.
"Everyone, be careful to keep a low profile. This is the territory of the elves. When setting traps, don't destroy the trees casually, as you will provoke the hatred of the elves."
"Group of four, don't separate. If you have a god skin, open it. If you don't have one, make sure you have wind magic on hand at all times. Once you receive Ava's alarm, activate the wind wall immediately!"
"Understood!"
Teams of hundreds of players responded one after another and got busy in various parts of the forest.
"By the way, why did these two people suddenly end up in the elves' territory?"
"Who knows..."
The two of them had assigned tasks and were chatting when a scream suddenly sounded from the communicator.
"Ah..."
Before the shout could end, three more voices sounded one after another.
"What's going on?" the devil asked quickly.
"Coordinates R area 145, 265, four members were attacked by enemies and died on the spot!" Ava reported.
"How is that possible? Didn't I ask you to alert me at any time?"
"There was no time-space wavelength response in the combat area...the enemy used other means to get close to our members," Ava said.
"Other means?" Everyone was shocked. They are all well-armed elites, and their abilities are highly complementary. Ordinary means will not work. The only way to achieve the current invisible effect is divine power.
In other words, the other two have gained new divine power during this period?
All the elites present immediately realized that this time the enemy suddenly came to the Elf Forest. Could it be a 'trap' for them, trying to lure them in, and then use the information gap to kill them and take revenge?
"The spatio-temporal reaction has appeared again...it is in an uninhabited area...the other party is changing position..." Ava's report sounded again.
"All members, immediately enter the defense mode and shrink the front line inward." The emperor ordered into the communicator, and at the same time turned on the divine skin and rushed towards the location of the incident at full speed.
The emperor's calm voice temporarily calmed everyone's nervousness.
However, the next second, there were several screams in succession, mixed with a man's sneer.
"Haha, it's too late!"
Somewhere at the edge of the forest, Z World Walker looked at the corpses of the four players who died tragically in front of him, gestured to the red sleeves in the distance, and was about to continue to the next location.
A sound breaking through the air suddenly struck from the side.
Z World Walker frowned, but didn't pay too much attention. He subconsciously pressed his fingers, and the time around him naturally stopped.
The stop boundary was opened, and Z Realm Walker turned his head with the victory in hand, wanting to see first who was the rat who dared to take the initiative to attack him.
However, when he turned around, what greeted him was a sickle blade that had not frozen in time.
"Poof!"
The sword flashed, leaving a line of blood on the Z Realm Walker's neck. Along with the blood, the soul of the Z Realm Walker splattered out.
Opposite, on Lin Xue's body, the shadow of the God of Death has already appeared for the first time.Time emerged, reaching out to skim the mass of souls in the air, and swallowed it in one gulp.
The stop boundary is naturally lifted.
"No!"
The woman's mournful cry rang out, and Hongxiu, who sensed something was wrong not far away, ran over, but was still a step too late. She could only watch her husband's body lose life and fall straight to the ground.
Hongxiu was stagnant on the spot and couldn't come back to her senses for a while.
After more than ten seconds, she raised her head again and stared at Lin Xue, her eyes red and her face distorted: "I want you to die!"
Hongxiu rushed towards Lin Xue with the death chain in hand.
Lin Xue just looked at her quietly, holding the sickle with both hands.
The limit suddenly opened at this moment.
Hongxiu was frozen in place, falling into a stasis of time, while her bulging belly squirmed, revealing a baby's face, which was the left mound where Hongxiu's child was reincarnated.
This face was looking at Lin Xue across from him with an expression of extreme horror. The death of the Z Realm Walker just now had made him understand something. How could he dare to fight forward? He hurriedly controlled the red sleeves dominated by anger, turned around and ran away into the distance.
As soon as Hongxiu set off, an oval-shaped portal appeared not far ahead.
But just when Hongxiu was about to step into the teleportation formation, a blade pierced Hongxiu from behind, pierced her abdomen, and brought out the unformed baby inside.
Zuoqiu was covered in blood and was impaled on the tip of the sickle. His face was twisted in pain, and the vitality in his body quickly disappeared.
Before he died, looking at the expressionless woman below, he still had one last question in his mind: Why would a time observer appear in this place...
"What? You said the battle is over?"
"Yes, another group of players appeared on the scene. The opponent should have ambushed them in advance. They killed two... no, three enemies in a short period of time."
"..."
Listening to Ava's report on the communicator, a group of people from the Emperor and the Divine Right of Kings quickly came from all directions and surrounded the crime scene.
As soon as they arrived at the scene, everyone saw three corpses on the ground, a man, a woman and a baby. Among them, the woman had a hole in her abdomen and the fetus was missing. The woman seemed to be aging rapidly, turning into an old man with white hair and a withered body. She died with extreme unwillingness and fear.
At this moment, everyone had no time to pay attention to the three corpses. Instead, they all stared at the only figure still standing in the field as if they were facing a formidable enemy.
It was a woman wearing a red robe and holding a scythe. Her face was pale and she looked a little sickly. Her eyes were bloodshot and the dark circles were extremely thick. She seemed to have not slept for a long time.
Although this woman looked like she had been seriously injured, no one dared to approach her at this moment. After all, the Death God skin floating on her body was not a decoration.
Everyone looked at each other, a little shocked.
Judging from the situation at the scene, it was obvious that these three people died in the hands of this woman. You must know that this couple was the enemy that they had been chasing for more than half a year but failed to succeed... Everyone was curious, how strong was this woman?
"Xiao Xue!"
"Sister Xue!"
Lu Yao and Xiaoya walked out of the jungle nearby and quickly ran to Lin Xue, but they both looked at Lin Xue in horror.
It is now the fourth day since they arrived in the Elf Forest. Four days ago, when Lu Yao heard Lin Xue say that she would ambush the 'Z World Walker' here, she was already prepared for a fierce battle. After all, this Z World Walker is the most wanted criminal in the world. He has been elusive all day long, and a large number of players have died at the hands of the opponent.
As a result, when it came time to actually take action, Lin Xue just asked her to use the relic to help hide her figure, then approached the enemy alone, and then completed the instant kill when no one knew what happened.
"Ahem...beauties, do you also have grudges against these two people?"
Opposite, after the Divine Right of Kings and the others were silent, the lastThe sociable ‘smile’ speaks on behalf of everyone.
The three people on the opposite side have defeated the Z Realm Walker. Logically speaking, they should not be enemies, but this woman still has the skin of the God of Death...
You must know that the God of Death has always been the symbol of the Z Realm Walker's accomplice. In the past six months, they have conducted a lot of research on the God of Death, but they did not expect that a new agent of the God of Death would appear now, which made everyone unable to distinguish between ourselves and the enemy.
Combined with the location and time of the woman's appearance, everyone had already guessed that the two Z Realm Walkers suddenly changed their direction and came to the Elf Forest, most likely to find this woman.
"Called an enemy... But this time, the person I really want to find is you." Lin Xue suddenly looked at the emperor.
Everyone was stunned and looked at the emperor.
"I wonder what your Excellency has to do with me?" The emperor looked calmly, and while responding to Lin Xue, he quickly communicated with Ava in his mind, asking Ava to find out Lin Xue's identity.
In the blink of an eye, Lin Xue's numerous information on the earth was presented to the emperor.
The Emperor was surprised and at a loss when he looked at these information. What surprised him was that Lin Xue's identity was very ordinary and his behavior was extremely low-key. He never expected that there were such masters hidden among the people in China.
What was at a loss was that he really couldn't see any connection between Lin Xue's identity and background and his.
"You have sealed the entrance to the dream world, right?" Lin Xue asked.
"It's me." The emperor nodded.
"Very good, I need you to help me hold Xiaoya who is beside me with quick eyes and hands.
"...Just think of it as my reward for helping you kill these three wanted persons. "Lin Xue added.
The emperor frowned when he heard this, looked at the three people on the ground, and then looked at Lin Xue: "Can I ask why? "
What he asked was why the other party wanted to enter the dream world. As far as he knew, it was already dominated by nightmare beasts, and there was no value in exploring it.
"To save someone. "
"Save who? "
“My love is also the savior of this world. "
As soon as these words came out, the group of people on the opposite side frowned.
Savior?
"Beauty, can you speak more clearly? What does savior mean? The world would be destroyed without him? "The devil asked with a frown.
"Yes, this is a world without hope. Because the savior failed to be born, the history of this world line has deviated from the track. Humanity will eventually be defeated by the God-Eating Beast many years later and become extinct in the Catastrophe a hundred years later. "Lin Xue tried to speak as fast as possible, but fast but not cluttered. She knew that it would be difficult for the other party to believe her unless she said something clearly.
After hearing this, everyone looked at each other with even weirder expressions.
"How do you know this kind of thing? "Some people questioned.
"Because, I am not from this time and space, but from another world line - the correct world line. "Lin Xue said.
"Huh? "
The first person to question was not the people with the divine right of kings, but Lu Yao and Xiaoya. Both of them looked at Lin Xue in shock and confusion.
When everyone in the Divine Right of Kings saw the performance of the other three, they all felt it was even more unreasonable. Even your own companions didn't know about their feelings? How to make them believe it?
Next, everyone asked Lin Xue about many details of the so-called 'another world', and Lin Xue answered them one by one.
But when she heard her talk about the last world, where the Emperor and the Divine Right of Kings were defeated by someone else, and the Lord of the City of Order was replaced by someone else, the devil was the first to sneer: "Nonsense, you said the Emperor lost to someone else? How is that possible? I don't believe that anyone in this world can be better than the Emperor! "
Lin Xue did not answer the devil, but looked at the emperor and said seriously: "You are very good, but unfortunately, you are not the 'right' person. No matter how powerful you are in cultivation, no matter how capable you are of leadership, and how you can unite all mankind around the world, you cannot save the world. "
“Then what kind of person do you think can save the world? "Someone asked. Listening to Lin Xue continuously belittling the leader, everyoneThere was anger in my heart.
"Children of Time."
Lin Xue gave a specious answer.
"Children of Time?"
"What the hell..."
Everyone on the opposite side started shouting. They all felt that this woman was talking nonsense, and no one believed her.
The emperor, on the other hand, had been meditating calmly. Until just now when Lin Xue said 'son of time', his expression suddenly changed and he looked at Lin Xue with some surprise.
"There is no time, the dream world must be opened immediately, otherwise, I don't know how long he can last!" Lin Xue suddenly urged anxiously.
"Emperor, you don't really believe her words, do you? This woman is obviously a lunatic and she is just talking nonsense! We spent a lot of money to seal the dream world, how can we unblock it casually?" The devil looked at the emperor to persuade her.
"Can a madman help us deal with the enemy that we have been chasing for half a year and have been unable to catch him?" the emperor asked.
The demon was choked and speechless.
Everyone else was blushing a little too.
There was no way, their actual record was right in front of them, and everyone had nothing to say.
The emperor looked at Lin Xue: "Since you are in a hurry, come with me."
After saying that, he took off and flew deep into the forest.
Seeing that the emperor was persuaded, Lin Xue finally breathed a sigh of relief, letting Xiaoya and Lu Yao lead them and followed him.
The other people with the divine right of kings looked at each other and hurriedly followed.
The group passed through the teleportation array and soon came to the Emerald City again, under the World Tree.
This time Riley did not stop and directly let the tree people pass, but only Tianzi, Lin Xue, Xiaoya and Lu Yao were allowed to land on the World Tree.
"I believe you, not because you helped kill those two people..."
While the wooden 'elevator' was moving, the emperor suddenly opened his mouth to explain.
"It's because I have had some feelings of confusion in the past, especially after I succeeded the Lord of Order City. I always felt that my current identity was unreal, as if it was not supposed to belong to me, but to another person..."
"I can foresee that if this continues, the world will eventually reach an ending that I can't handle..."
The emperor seemed to be talking to himself, and the three women behind him also listened without saying a word.
"In short, I cannot let the future of this world be destroyed in my hands... For this reason, I am willing to take a gamble..."
The emperor then turned around and looked directly at Lin Xue: "So, if there is really the person you mentioned... bring him back and restore the world to what it should be..."
"Thank you, I will." Lin Xue nodded seriously.
She is now very glad that the Lord of Order in this world is the Emperor. Otherwise, if it were someone else, even if they believed her words, there would be a big question mark as to whether they would be willing to give up this position of 'number one' and act as a green leaf for others.
After a while, the four of them reached the tree crown, and under the leadership of Riley, they arrived at the core of the World Tree, between dreams.
During this moment of deep dreaming, the surrounding walls were covered with dense runes of order, which were seals that separated the two worlds.
The Emperor took out the Pen of Order, and before taking action, he looked at Lin Xue: "Let me tell you first, although I believe in you, I will not ignore the world."
"In order to prevent the real world from being invaded by nightmare beasts, in
“That is to say, if you die in the dream world, you will really die and there will be no chance of coming back. "The emperor looked at Lin Xue and reiterated the risks of this operation with a serious expression.
"I understand, let's get started. "
Lin Xue nodded. From the moment she entered here, she had no intention of coming back.
"Sister Xue..."
At this time, Xiaoya and Lu Yao behind them both looked at Lin Xue worriedly.
Lin Xue also looked at the two of them apologetically: "Sorry, I really don't have time to explain. I have to leave immediately... I'm sorry..."
The people she feels most guilty about in this world are Lu Yao and Xiaoya. They have helped her a lot these days, but theyShe didn't even have time to explain the situation clearly... although she did explain that they would soon forget it under the power of correction.
In the blink of an eye, the Emperor had already waved his brush, and as the runes of order flowed on the wall, an oval-shaped opening gradually took shape in the middle of the dense runes.
The emperor nodded to Lin Xue.
Lin Xue quickly ran to a wooden bed, lay down and closed her eyes.
A dream butterfly hovered naturally on her forehead...
When Lin Xue opened her eyes again, she had already appeared in the dream world.
But the dream world in front of him was very different from what he remembered. The originally fairy tale-style world was now filled with dense black shadows.
This thing that looks like a shadow ghost is the so-called nightmare beast.
They have reproduced for countless generations in this unruly world. Looking around at this moment, the surroundings are filled with darkness, filled with such things.
The nearest nightmare beast quickly discovered Lin Xue and roared towards her.
Lin Xue hurriedly manifested the death sickle and slashed it out. The nightmare beast was cut in half and turned into black energy and dissipated.
This thing seems to be more fragile than expected, but there are too many to hold it, and even if it is killed, the black energy will quickly condense and form again in a nearby location.
The surrounding nightmare beasts were awakened by the movement here, and more black shadows rushed towards them. Lin Xue hurriedly continued to swing his sword, killing one nightmare beast after another.
However, looking at the dark sight with no end in sight, Lin Xue could not help but feel a sense of despair in her heart.
To get to the heart of time in the dream world, you must first think about this place in your mind, and then keep walking for a day and night, and then the heart of time will appear.
In other words, she must fight here non-stop for 24 hours...
Lin Xue tried her best to drag her tired body and swing her knife to disperse the few black shadows around her, but her eyelids felt terribly heavy.
If it was normal, forget it, but she had stayed up for four or five nights in a row before, and her body was already extremely sleepy. Next, she had to continue fighting with high intensity day and night. Can she really do it? Of course she has enough motivation and perseverance, but some things cannot be done with willpower alone...
Just when Lin Xue felt a little desperate, a ray of green light fell on her body, healing her wounds and boosting her spirit and physical strength at the same time.
Lin Xue turned around in surprise and saw Xiaoya appearing in the dream world behind her.
She was only wearing thin clothes, and she barely had a wand in her hand, struggling to maintain the magic.
"Xiaoya, you..."
Lin Xue was surprised, she really didn't expect Xiaoya to follow her in.
She came here with the sole intention of going to the Heart of Time to find her true love, and she never thought about leaving when she came in. But what about Xiaoya?
No matter what her reason was, once she entered here, there was no way out. In other words, the moment she fell asleep, she was ready to sacrifice here...
After thinking about this, Lin Xue looked at Xiaoya with both emotion and sadness, not knowing what to say.
At this time, Xiaoya finally gradually adapted to the rules of reality, gathered more clothes on her body, looked at Lin Xue and said with a smile: "Sister Xue, you don't have to blame yourself, this is my own decision and has nothing to do with you."
"The moment the emperor opened the entrance to the dream just now, I suddenly felt very familiar. Until I actually came in at this time, I became more and more sure that I must have been here before..."
Xiaoya looked at Lin Xue with tears in her eyes and said with a smile: "Sister Xue, that person who is important to you and me, you must bring him back. This is also my wish!"
Just as she finished speaking, Lin Xue suddenly burst into flames and threw her aside, narrowly dodging a nightmare beast attacking from behind.
But the two fell to the ground, giving more nightmare beasts a chance.
Seeing such a good opportunity, several of the nearest black shadows around them rushed towards the two of them like crazy.
But just when the two of them were about to die,At that moment, several fireballs were fired from behind, accurately hitting several shadows.
"Lu Yao?"
Lin Xue looked at the acquaintance who had just appeared behind him and was surprised again.
"Hey, why are the local rules so troublesome? Please teach me how to manifest the relics!"
From behind, Lu Yao came up cursing.
After getting closer, Lu Yao scratched her head and said awkwardly when she met the questioning gazes of the two people: "Oh, don't look at me like that, okay? I just couldn't bear to watch you two die one by one, so the boss came in after me. In fact, I regret it so much now! Why did I go crazy with you two in here..."
As Lu Yao explained, more shadows were coming from the surrounding area.
The three of them could only suspend their communication and hurriedly released magic back to back to disperse the nearby black shadows one by one.
"Hey, Xiaoxue, according to you, as long as 'that person' you mentioned is rescued, the world will be corrected back to normal, and we will be able to live again by then, right?"
Taking advantage of the break in the battle, Lu Yao asked.
"Well, of course!" Lin Xue nodded quickly.
"That's good..."
Lu Yao breathed a sigh of relief and said with a relieved smile: "Otherwise, the three of us will die here together, and no one will even burn paper to each other in the future, hahaha..."
"..."
Lin Xue was so moved that she couldn't say any more words of gratitude. She only knew that there were two more reasons why this operation must not fail.
With the two people joining us, the originally difficult journey became much easier.
Lu Yao quickly learned to manifest the relics. Under the concealment effect of her relics, the frequency of the three people's battles was greatly reduced.
In this way, he finally succeeded in surviving a whole day and night among countless nightmare beasts.
The next day, the thirty-fifth day after Lin Xue came to this world, the city of time that she had longed for appeared before her eyes again.
The dream forest in front of the city seemed to have been eaten away by the Nightmare Beast Gate, and the door to the Heart of Time was opened directly in the fog ahead.
Lin Xue's physical fatigue had reached the extreme at this time, but she still held on to her spirit and stumbled towards the city gate.
But it wasn't until she approached the city gate that she realized that the two people behind her were not following. When she looked back, she found that Xiaoya and Lu Yao had been blocked by the nightmare beast, and were almost drowned by the wave of black shadows.
Lin Xue subconsciously wanted to rescue her, but the two people in the distance waved their hands desperately, telling her not to come over and hurry up to complete what they had to do.
Lin Xue bit her lip, turned around cruelly, and ran towards the city gate even faster, towards the place of heartbreak and destiny...
In the room, Mu You slowly opened his eyes, with a heavy sigh and a look of vicissitudes of life flashing through his eyes.
Scenes of memories came to mind, and he finally completely remembered the experiences he and Lin Xue had experienced during those two thousand years.
In front of him, his daughter was still fumbling with his beard and babbling: "Mom, don't cry, mom, don't cry..."
"Don't worry, I promise I won't make your mother cry again..."
Mu You looked at her daughter with relief, picked her up, and rushed out of the door impatiently.
In the study room on the second floor.
Lin Xue sat in the sunshine on the window sill, knitting a ball of yarn according to the tutorial.
The sound of footsteps sounded, Mu You hugged his daughter and suddenly pushed the door open and entered.
Lin Xue was stunned, looking at his hurried expression, and couldn't help but laugh: "Why are you so anxious? You are a father now, so you need to be more steady..."
